messages:
maria: Heads-up — we have the SRE candidate scheduled for next Tue. Original calendar was 10:00–11:00 PT but a couple people flagged conflicts. Can folks confirm availability so I can lock the panel and the debrief flow? Also two quick rubric clarifications below.
sam: I can cover the slot but prefer start at 10:15 if that's ok. I have a standing 10:00 sync that usually overruns.
jeff: 10:15 works for me.
maria: OK setting provisional start to 10:15. Recruiter sent invite but please double-check the calendar entry if you have any restrictions. Recruiter link to candidate confirmation: https://cal.example/candidate/abc123
recruiter-bot: Candidate confirmed — calendar invites sent to panel. Reminder: please complete the debrief form within 24h after the interview: https://docs.example.com/debriefs/SRE-template
maria: Rubric Q1 — on the "system design" row, do we evaluate "scope (features covered)" separately from "depth (tradeoffs + bottlenecks)"? Some panels mark 'meets' when candidates only sketched endpoints.
jeff: My take: depth matters more. If they identify concrete tradeoffs and limitations and sketch mitigations that's meets. High-level feature lists without reasoning = below.
sam: Agree with jeff. Maybe call out examples in the rubric header so reviewers are consistent.
maria: Good idea. I'll add a short clarifier into the form: "Assess depth first: tradeoffs, capacity, failure modes; scope is secondary"
olivia: I can be backup coverage for the panel but I'd need 15 min after my standup — so 10:15 start is perfect.
maria: Perfect — olivia noted as backup. Second rubric Q: scoring scale for the coding exercise — is it 1–4 or 1–5? I remember we discussed changing it last quarter.
sam: I remember the switch but never updated my mental model. Which one are we using now?
maria: We standardized on 1–4 across engineering interviews (4=exceeds, 3=meets, 2=below, 1=poor). I'll paste that as a tool-tip in the debrief form.
jeff: Also can we do a shared doc for notes (single source of truth) instead of separate emails? I'll create "SRE-Interview-Notes (shared)" and paste the template.
maria: Yes please. Single doc + the debrief form link is ideal.
recruiter-bot: Tip: if you need to swap a panelist last-minute, ping #oncall-engineering and tag the candidate ID.
olivia: Noted. Thanks everyone.
sam: I'm good with 10:15 start and will fill the debrief within 24h. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks all — I'll update invites to 10:15, add the rubric clarifier to the form, and post the shared notes doc link here once created.
